recognize_zh: PML/RARA 雙色雙融合（DC-DF）探針：左下細胞可見 1 個黃色融合訊號加 2 紅 2 綠（1F2R2G），右上細胞為 2 紅 2 綠的正常型態；只有一個融合點屬非典型型態，提示可能涉及第三條染色體的複雜轉位。
features: Interphase FISH with PML (orange/red) and RARA (green) dual-color dual-fusion probe on DAPI-counterstained nuclei
Lower-left nucleus: one yellow fusion signal, two red, and two green signals (1F2R2G, atypical pattern)
Upper-right nucleus: two red and two green separate signals without fusion (2R2G, normal pattern)
Expected classic t(15;17) pattern with this probe is 2F1R1G, which is not seen here
describe_en: Interphase FISH using a PML/RARA dual-color dual-fusion probe shows two nuclei. One nucleus shows a single fusion signal together with two orange (PML) and two green (RARA) signals (1F2R2G), whereas the other shows a normal 2R2G pattern. The single-fusion pattern with retained extra signals departs from the classic reciprocal 2F1R1G pattern and suggests a variant or complex (three-way) rearrangement, or an insertion, involving PML and RARA. Correlation with karyotype, metaphase FISH, and PML-RARA RT-PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Balanced reciprocal translocation gives two fusion signals with one red and one green (2F1R1G) in the dual-fusion system.
No PML-RARA fusion is formed, so a RARA break-apart probe splits while the PML/RARA fusion probe shows no fusion.
Small inserted fusion may produce one small fusion signal with otherwise normal counts, requiring RT-PCR confirmation.
Chance colocalization occurs in a low percentage of normal cells, so a cutoff established on normal controls is required.
